prompt: Which combination should the operator try for the next clipped proof?
promptZh: 操作員下一次試裝校樣時，應採用哪種組合？

options.text: Blue mounting position; picture in the lower space on the left when facing the printed side.
options.zh: 裝在藍色位置；面向印刷面時，將圖放在左下方空間。
options.whyZh: 藍色位置能在不取下固定夾的情況下讀到完整序號。背面照片中卡舌在左下方，對調到直立正面是右下方；圖放正面左下方可避開卡舌，也不會跨過序號開孔。

options.text: Blue mounting position; picture in the lower space on the right when facing the printed side.
options.zh: 裝在藍色位置；面向印刷面時，將圖放在右下方空間。
options.whyZh: 序號可完整讀出，但把圖放在正面右下方會被卡舌遮住。照片的背面左下方正是正面右下方。

options.text: White mounting position; picture in the lower space on the right when facing the printed side.
options.zh: 裝在白色位置；面向印刷面時，將圖放在右下方空間。
options.whyZh: 改裝白色位置使卡舌移到正面左下方，圖放右下方能避開它；但固定夾在白色位置會遮到序號的最後一碼。

options.text: White mounting position; picture in the lower space on the left when facing the printed side.
options.zh: 裝在白色位置；面向印刷面時，將圖放在左下方空間。
options.whyZh: 白色位置使卡舌移到正面左下方，會遮到圖；同時固定夾也會遮到序號的最後一碼。

explanationZh: 藍色位置能在不取下固定夾的情況下讀到完整序號。背面照片中卡舌在左下方，對調到直立正面是右下方；圖放正面左下方可避開卡舌，也不會跨過序號開孔。
evidence: Below the bar there is room for the full picture on either side of the opening / with the clip still fitted. / the blue mounting position left the full number readable. / the edge of the clip hid its last character. / Switching between them moves the short retaining tab to the opposite side. / shows the blue position from behind the card, with the top edge still at the top of the photo. / masking the lower-left space in that rear view. / with the printed face toward you and the card upright.

vocabulary.note: 指固定夾裝在卡片上的位置；不等於同一張卡上圖面要印的位置。
